# neon-theme-pack (fake)

A made-up community theme pack: `neon-glow-theme` and its child `neon-sunset-theme`. Declarative (`kind: pack`), MIT licensed, not core. Used to test theme packs: registry entries, a child theme, the tag prefix rule, and the "theme in use" rule when disabling.
